column1: # Fake Lake is a simulated site used in pcountr vignettes and examples.
# Pollen assemblages are derived from real counts but depths and ages are
# fictional. Do not cite or interpret these data as real stratigraphy.

# Option B — per-sample metadata via set_metadata():
# file            YAML filename stem (e.g. FL001 for FL001.yaml)

# age_bottom      Age at bottom of interval
